meta.description: Trekly's editorial top 100 Canadian trails. List order is the editorial popularity rank.

fields.latitude_longitude: Point of the OSM feature named in verification.coordinates (trailhead/start feature where OSM has one, otherwise the destination).
fields.max_elevation_m: OSM ele tag of the high point / destination; else the pre-existing row value (verification source legacy) or a reviewer override (manual); null otherwise.
fields.elevation_gain_m: Net gain between OSM ele of start and high point; else the pre-existing row value (verification source legacy); null otherwise.
fields.route_type: out_and_back, loop or point_to_point, a reviewer judgement from the mapped geometry and the hike; null when distance_km is null.
fields.distance_km: What a hiker covers, from the OSM hiking route relation or named trail ways in verification.distance_km (great-circle sum of way segments): twice the mapped length for an out_and_back (the round trip), the loop length for a loop, the full one-way length for a point_to_point route. Only where the mapped feature is one clean line or loop covering the hike; null otherwise.
